int_name: E DUNCANNON AVE & RISING SUN AVE

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, sidewalks, and signalization. However, the wide roadway and lack of mid-crossing refuges increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the main roadway without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Mature trees and utility poles near the corners may partially obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners of the foreground intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing transverse markings to continental or ladder style to increase visibility to approaching motorists.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection featuring a marked zebra crosswalk, sidewalks, and traffic signals. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the environment is compromised by parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines and a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side of the image block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, upstream of the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signalization
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection, no dedicated pedestrian walk/don't-walk signals are visible, which can lead to crossing uncertainty.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on the remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps with tactile paving. However, large trees on the corner create a significant visual obstruction for drivers and pedestrians, and dedicated pedestrian signals are not visible.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large evergreen trees on the corner may block the view of pedestrians waiting to cross for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the corner.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing instructions and improve safety.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks and traffic signals, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the absence of dedicated pedestrian signals and the presence of a stone wall that may obstruct sightlines for shorter pedestrians are notable safety concerns.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross and may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction
hazards.description: A stone wall at the corner may obstruct the visibility of shorter pedestrians, such as children, for turning motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left corner of the intersection along the sidewalk
